nodes.description: Library-level constant state variable NUM_TRAITS = 9, bounds the outer trait loop in roll.
Library-level constant state variable MAX_LENGTH = 40, sizes the genes lookup table and inner loop.
External view function roll(uint seed, uint nonce) that derives pseudo-random traits from block entropy and returns uint[NUM_TRAITS].
Function parameter seed, caller-supplied entropy mixed into the keccak256 seed derivation.
Function parameter nonce, caller-supplied counter that is post-incremented and hashed into every keccak256 round.
Miner/validator-influenced block timestamp used as entropy in the keccak256 randomness derivation.
Modulo arithmetic randomSeed % races[1][1] and randomSeed % genes[i][2+r][MAX_LENGTH-1] used to select race and trait indices.
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.difficulty, seed, block.timestamp, nonce++)) weak randomness source dependent on manipulable block values.
Post-increment nonce++ performed on a function parameter inside the hash expression.
Local fixed-size array uint[NUM_TRAITS] holding the generated trait values returned by roll.
Local lookup table uint[MAX_LENGTH][4][NUM_TRAITS] of cumulative trait thresholds.
Local uint[2][2] race table initialized to [[1,2],[50,100]] and used for race selection.
Local seed value produced by keccak256 and re-hashed each loop iteration.
Local race index r used to select the gene sub-array variant.
Local per-trait threshold value computed as randomSeed % maxGene.
Outer loop counter iterating over traits (1..NUM_TRAITS-1).
Inner loop counter iterating over MAX_LENGTH gene thresholds.

edges.reason: Caller-supplied seed parameter is consumed by roll.
Caller-supplied nonce parameter is consumed by roll.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 entropy, making randomness timestamp dependent.
seed is packed into the keccak256 preimage.
nonce is packed into the keccak256 preimage.
randomSeed local variable is assigned from the timestamp-dependent keccak256 output.
randomSeed is taken modulo the race table maximum to select a race.
Modulo-derived race index writes traits[0] through races[0][i].
randomSeed modulo the max gene value produces traitSeed.
Post-increment nonce++ mutates the nonce parameter used in the hash.
roll populates and returns the traits array.
roll initializes and reads the genes lookup table.
roll initializes and reads the races table.
roll assigns the race index r during race selection.
NUM_TRAITS bounds the outer loop and array size inside roll.
MAX_LENGTH determines the gene threshold array length.
roll controls the outer loop counter i.
roll controls the inner loop counter j.
genes thresholds are compared against traitSeed for trait selection.
races table supplies the modulus and thresholds for race selection.
Race index r selects the genes sub-array used by the modulo lookup.
block.timestamp is read inside roll via the keccak256 randomness expression.

normalization_plan.reason: seed is a parameter used only to compute the seed of roll; merge the parameter node into the roll function node.
nonce is a parameter whose value exists solely to feed roll's hashing loop; merge into roll.
traits is the local return array produced by roll; merge into the roll function node.
genes is a local constant lookup table initialized and consumed inside roll; merge into roll.
races is a local table initialized and consumed only within roll; merge into roll.
randomSeed is the local result of the unsafe keccak256 randomness operation; merge into keccak_randomness.
r is the local race index produced by the modulo-based race selection unsafe operation; merge into modulo_randomness.
traitSeed is the local value derived from the modulo threshold computation; merge into modulo_randomness.
i is the outer loop counter fully controlled by roll; merge into roll.
j is the inner loop counter fully controlled by roll; merge into roll.
